false_accept_surfaces.title: Checker independence is substring-shaped rather than identity-bound
false_accept_surfaces.finding: A reviewer role saying 'checker and implementer of this mechanism' satisfies independence because the text contains 'checker'. The gate never compares checker identity with maker/auditor identities or commit authorship.

false_accept_surfaces.title: Revision and verdict aliases are not globally conflict-closed or review-bound
false_accept_surfaces.finding: An object verdict with status=ACCEPT and verdict=REJECT accepts the first field. Only aliases inside revisions are compared; contradictory top-level account/implementation/evaluated revisions are ignored. The implementation need only descend from the account, so a commit made after the authored review can be substituted. Java is checked only as a matching 40-hex string, not as an external PlantUML commit.

false_accept_surfaces.title: One physical input can satisfy two-input/two-axis acceptance and be reused across mechanisms
false_accept_surfaces.finding: Source and golden uniqueness are path-based, used_goldens resets per review, inode/content identity is never compared, and axes are case-sensitive free text. Hardlinks or copied identical content under local same-stem paths can count as multiple held-outs; 'label' and 'LABEL' count as two axes.

false_accept_surfaces.title: Java process failure metadata is ignored
false_accept_surfaces.finding: java_exit/oracle_exit and preserved .java.exit artifacts are not consulted. A stale non-error SVG plus result=pass and java_exit=1 selects as Java-success evidence.

false_accept_surfaces.title: Rejected canonical records receive weaker completeness checks
false_accept_surfaces.finding: Exact revisions, explicit identity/model/tool, independence, findings, and evidence validation are enforced only for accepted latest reviews. A rejected latest review can suppress an earlier acceptance while carrying only a weak historical reviewer marker and commands.

Git cannot cryptographically establish model identity or whether an attested checker was operated by the same human as an implementer; the gate must at least reject explicit same-implementer claims and bind auditable task/commit identities.
The temporary mutation tests were removed to obey checker-only delivery. The bypasses have no permanent regression tests at this head.
